conditions.transport: LAN direct to isolated local KonomiTV
conditions.playback: recorded MPEG-2 TS Original, YADIF double-rate, true fullscreen
conditions.warmup: first two distant seeks in each fresh tab excluded
conditions.tabRule: zero matching pages before each block; one foreground page during the block; playback stopped and page closed after every block
conditions.visibleFrame: first direct YADIF canvas draw after a new post-seek rVFC, with computed visibility=visible and opacity!=0

implementation.commonBase: tsukumijima/mpeg2toh264 52a3db5 plus YADIF queue successor source 26484fd and seek timing instrumentation
implementation.fixedDifference: remove the first-fragment write that paired the range start byte with the later first-fragment media timestamp

interpretation.cause: the old first-fragment write corrupts a measured byte-to-PTS sample by assigning the source range start to a later output timestamp
interpretation.mechanism: the corrupted interpolation often opens one or two GOPs earlier on subsequent seeks; Chrome then decodes and discards more media before satisfying the requested playhead
interpretation.network: the fix also removed all repeated timestamp probes in these blocks, but first-fragment arrival alone did not show a stable target-paired improvement
interpretation.effect: the target-paired presented and visible-canvas intervals exclude zero, supporting a real user-visible improvement rather than only fewer requests
interpretation.remaining: the fixed visible-canvas median and p90 remain above the stable 250 ms goal, and the presented-to-canvas tail remains variable

excludedRuns.reason: stage-only collector captured the first post-seek canvas call before proving that it followed a new frame
one canvas sample was captured while computed visibility was hidden; collector was tightened and the complete block was rerun
